_comment: An address is recorded here ONLY after gen_getContractSchema (and get_config) confirm it is live. An empty address means not deployed, and the frontend fails closed on it.

studio_next.verified_by: gen_getContractSchema returned 16 methods (7 view, 9 write) and the expected ctor; get_config returned unit_face=100e18, max_units=5, claim_bond=5e18, fee_bps=500, max_judge_attempts=3, expiry_window_seconds=259200, treasury=0xC6E6...4537, 4 discrete decisions; get_policy returned the frozen text intact; get_solvency reported is_solvent=true at zero exposure; get_board returned an empty board. All checks PASS (deploy/verify.mjs).

superseded.reason: Deployed, live and schema-valid, but its frozen policy text was corrupted in transit: solventlib.canonicalize.sanitize_text replaced the literal word 'END' case-insensitively, turning 'independently' into 'indep ently' and so changing policy_hash. Fixed to strip only delimiter-impersonation tokens (brackets/fences), covered by a regression test, and redeployed to the address above.
